name: Vault
text: Private-bank statement: ivory paper, serif figures, the stake shown like a statement of holdings. For the cautious holder on a Ledger.

name: Terminal
text: Operator console: monospace, dense tables, a terminal session where the withdraw fails with LockupInForce. For validators.

name: Editorial
text: Magazine story in chapters: the thefts first, then the lock already inside every stake account, then how Stakeward turns it on.

name: Guided
text: Friendly fintech, phone first: soft cards, helper bubbles, a big shield medallion with your protection status.

name: Console
text: Security SaaS app shell: sidebar, KPI tiles, a protection ring and a dense accounts table.

name: Verdict first
text: One question, one answer. A giant wallet field; the accounts page opens with a one-line verdict on whether a thief can take your SOL.

name: Two futures
text: A key leak played out side by side: without the lock the SOL is gone, with Stakeward the withdraw is rejected and you rescue.

name: Safety checklist
text: A pre-flight checklist with a score: each item says what it protects against; the accounts page leads with your checks.

name: Conversation
text: A calm chat with a security expert: reply chips reveal the next answer, results arrive as messages with account cards.

name: Mechanism, drawn
text: A blueprint strongbox with two keyholes shows what each key can and cannot do; accounts become tiles sized by SOL.

name: Specimen
text: Data first: the stake account's real lockup record (who can withdraw, who must co-sign, until when) is the identity; every screen reads like the account itself.

name: Field manual
text: The recovery card leads: a lock plus a printed card with the real Solana CLI commands that work without Stakeward.

name: Tbilisi
text: An identity of its own for the Georgian track: Tbilisi palette and a carved-balcony motif used once, calm and warm.

name: Evidence
text: Only proof: live numbers from the network, monitor health and the gate checks run on devnet and mainnet, each with its result.

name: Plain utility
text: Public-service plain: task first, large readable type, no decoration; every page answers one question.
